name: Gates of the Arctic National Park
tagline: Gates of the Arctic — true wilderness; no roads or trails system for casual visits.

practical.ticket_note: No entrance station; access is fly-in wilderness.
practical.transit_note: No park roads; bush plane required.
practical.energy_note: Full wilderness skills required — not a toddler outing.
practical.best_start: Prep at regional visitor centers; only enter with guided/expedition plan
practical.slice_name: Gateway prep only for most families
